citation.title: Single Ingestion of Trehalose Enhances Prolonged Exercise Performance by Effective Use of Glucose and Lipid in Healthy Men

reported.what: blood glucose, water trial, 30 min after the drink (sample 5), mean ± SD, n = 12
blood glucose AUC from sample 4 to 12, water trial, mean ± SD, n = 12
catecholamine AUC from sample 4 to 12, water trial (adrenaline, noradrenaline, dopamine), mean ± SD, n = 12; unit not printed

detail: Every arm contains four Wingate sets of 3 x 30 s sprints, but the paper prints the sprint power only as a percentage of the first set (figure 3), never in watts or oxygen uptake, so the bout cannot be given an intensity; the clock minutes of the 12 blood samples and of the drink are shown only in Figure 1, and no resting or fasting value is printed as a number in text or table (Table 1 has only anthropometry and VO2peak).
